title: HashSmash projected scientific cell record, version 1

id.description: SHA-256 of kind, newline, canonical original parsed row. Does not include source appearance.

entity.description: Linking label, not a guarantee that conflicting editions describe equivalent instances.

rounds.description: Explicit target depth or parsed target suffix. Not notebook row_i, filename digits or digest width.

recorded_status.description: Original recorded disposition, not a fresh scientific verdict.

fields.description: Projected scientific source fields. Personal/operational fields are excluded; flagged text is held.

description: Raw data and frozen source snapshots remain private when they contain non-public fields. Use occurrences.csv for all source edges, sources.json for original-file SHA-256 pins and manifest.json for pinned projected chunks. Different typed layers are not interchangeable scientific units.
